## Start here

The suite has substantial craft knowledge and useful execution tools. The main opportunity is to connect explicit musical intent to safe, reproducible actions and honest evidence—not to add more theory skills or another universal quality score.

The user approved the full implementation roadmap. Execution then exposed safety and integration failures. The user subsequently asked to pause implementation and preserve the complete suggested fixes before closing the session. This document records that work; it does not declare the changes shipped.

- **47 skills; 18,980 entrypoint lines; 15 entrypoints exceed 500 lines.** These counts were observed again while drafting this handoff.
- Partial code for **all six capabilities** now exists in `desk`. That is not end-to-end acceptance.
- SSMP fidelity fixes, canonical-copy integration, procedure updates, progressive disclosure, and fresh-agent behavioral exercises remain unfinished.
- No final independent review accepted the implementation.
- REAPER became blocked during an earlier project-reopen operation involving missing samples. The user has now confirmed that its interface responds again.
